info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Management Manual Update API
info.description: The Management Manual Update API facilitates the modification of existing documentation within the banking knowledge assets. This endpoint allows authorized users to patch specific sections of the management manual, ensuring that the information remains current and relevant. It is primarily used by compliance officers and knowledge management teams to reflect organizational changes or regulatory updates. By using this API, businesses can maintain accurate records and support informed decision-making processes.

patch.description: This endpoint allows you to modify the details of a specific management manual asset identified by its resource ID. Provide the required fields in the request body to update information such as title, content, and related metadata.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to update the management manual identified by the given resource ID. It contains the required fields to modify specific properties of the management manual or to add new information. Ensure that the provided data adheres to the defined schema for a successful update.

200.description: The request was processed successfully, and the resource has been updated.
